title: Suryakumar Yadav Vs MI Conflict: Instagram Row Over Captaincy Escalates
summary: Suryakumar Yadav unfollowed the MI management on Instagram following a row over captaincy.
full_article_text: Suryakumar Yadav has unfollowed Mumbai Indians on Instagram after a major controversy erupted over captaincy decisions. The star batsman has been silent on the matter, but fans are reacting strongly. Shashank supported Shreyas Iyer following team decisions, while Tilak Varma continues to play a key role in the national cricket squad.
